# Personal decision system: 4-layer local decision knowledge engineering (SHORT FICHE)

Curated by Skill Harbor — a short pointer to @dontbesilent2025's personal decision system: a methodology that turns business, relationship, health, career, learning or investment decisions into a local file-based knowledge engineering setup with four fixed layers (01 facts append-only, 02 patterns slowly refined with dated corrections, 03 point-in-time snapshots never rewritten, 04 open questions cleared when resolved), plus source tagging ([本人] / [AI 推测] / [结果回填]), five work modes (init, status update, decision filing, result backfill, snapshot), a privacy mode with codename mapping, and hard guidance rules for the AI (don't write guesses as facts, stop offering plans when the user is procrastinating).
